newsitem.title: USA: Hain says closes Weight Watcher sale deal.
newsitem.headline: Hain says closes Weight Watcher sale deal.

text.p: UNIONDALE, N.Y., April 2 Reuter - The Hain Food Group Inc said it closed on March 31 a previously reported deal to manufacture and sell under a license arrangement approximately 60 food products of the Weight Watchers Gourmet Food Co, a wholly owned subsidiary of H.J. Heinz Co.
The initial license period for these products, which are sold throughout the U.S. and Puerto Rico, is for five years and is renewable under certain circumstances for additional five year periods.

Irwin Simon, president and chief executive officer of Hain, said Weight Watchers sales would compensate for Hain's reduced revenues on its rice cake products, which have been under pressure from competing snack items.
Sales of Weight Watchers products were approximately $17 million for the latest 12 month period, Simon said.
The Hain Food Group, headquartered in Uniondale, NY, is
a specialty food company which has a product portfolio comprised of seven key brands.
